engine.rationale: A 200 KiB complete-dist canonical gzip limit replaces the stale 130 KB active-doc claim and the workflow-only 170 KB tar estimate; it retains measured headroom without changing the measured artifact scope. Raised to a 256 KiB limit by the EvidenceRecord contract: the clean build at 99a902a measured 236,057 B against the 204,800 B blocking budget, and this working tree measures 237,324 B. Attribution is complete, not estimated — dist/src/evidence/** 23,384 B + dist/schema/evidence-record*.json 5,239 B + dist/evidence-verifier.mjs 9,898 B = 38,703 B for the evidence subsystem, so the non-evidence dist is 197,354 B and remains inside the previous budget: this spec is precisely what crosses it, and deleting the standalone verifier single file does not get back under it (226,159 B). The budget moves with the recorded numbers instead of the evidence surface shrinking to dodge the gate; baselineBytes stays at the 4465943 reference so the regression stays visible, and the advisory threshold keeps reporting it. Note that pnpm check does not run size:check and bundle-size.yml only triggers on packages/** changes, so this branch is the first to exercise that gate.
